name: Easy Spin — Reconnect
focus: Reactivate aerobic system after family pause, zero pressure

steps.description: Easy spin Z1, 80-90 rpm, HR <145 bpm — just find your rhythm
Steady Z2 aerobic, 85-95 rpm, HR 146-158 bpm — conversational effort, no surging
Easy spin, let HR drop below 130 bpm before stopping

name: Aerobic Ride — Gentle Extension
focus: Extend aerobic stimulus, steady Z2, rebuild consistency

steps.description: Easy spin Z1, 80-90 rpm — controlled build
Z2 steady aerobic, HR 146-162 bpm, cadence 88-95 rpm — if power drifts above 135W, ease back

name: Full-Body Strength — Shoulder-Safe Return
focus: Reactivate legs and core with zero shoulder load — healing shoulder fully protected
notes: 2 rounds (return week — reduced from 3): 10x Goblet Squat 16kg, 10x Romanian Deadlift 16kg, 8/leg TRX Split Squat bodyweight, 15x Banded Glute Bridge (band around knees, 2s hold at top), 8/side Dead Bug (slow and controlled), 10/side Pallof Press light band (anti-rotation). 60s rest between exercises, 90s between rounds. Shoulder note: zero overhead work, zero pressing, zero loading through shoulder joint. If RDL grip causes any shoulder discomfort, drop to 11kg dumbbells immediately.

steps.description: Leg swings 10 each leg, hip circles 10 each direction, bodyweight squats 10, glute bridges 10
2 rounds: Goblet Squat 10x16kg, RDL 10x16kg, TRX Split Squat 8/leg, Banded Glute Bridge 15x, Dead Bug 8/side, Pallof Press 10/side — 60s between exercises, 90s between rounds
Hip flexor stretch 30s each, hamstring stretch 30s each, deep glute stretch 30s each

name: Longer Aerobic Ride — Return Anchor
focus: Rebuild weekly long ride habit, progressive Z2 aerobic base

steps.description: Progressive build: start <100W, increase ~5W every 2 min, arrive at 110W — Z1 to low Z2, HR building to 146-150 bpm
Z2 aerobic, 88-95 rpm, HR 146-162 bpm — first repeat hold 110-120W, second repeat nudge to 120-135W if HR stable. Back off immediately if HR exceeds 165 bpm
Step down from 105W to below 90W by minute 8, spin to HR below 125 bpm before stopping
